thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 — detected elevated 99th percentile latency for canary pool `canary-eu-2` serving model `redwood/gpt-3.8-compat:v2.3.0-q8`. Start=2026-03-14T23:02:00Z. Alerting on >2500ms tail for 30s. Auto-escalation: oncall-jen paged.

oncall-jen: I'm picking this up. Initial ask: anyone seeing customer-facing errors? @support-alex pls confirm.

support-alex: A few customers reported higher response times for chat endpoints since ~23:03UTC, no 500s. One enterprise tenant (acme-corp) opened a ticket with slow response in onboarding flow.

sam-eng-sre: Joining. Pulling tracer spans and p99 token latencies from the canary cluster. I see a sharp delta at ~23:01:40 where tokengen step jumps from ~120ms to ~1.8s for some traces.

maria-ml: Noted. This is the new quantized kernel path (q8) that's enabled for v2.3.0 canary. Possible perf regression or kernel degrade under certain seq lengths.

lee-product: Customer impact: limited to canary pool only so far; good to keep product and support updated.

oncall-jen: T+2m timeline update: incident bot triggered, oncall paged, customer reports confirmed. Sam, can you post relevant logs and a short timeline in-thread?

sam-eng-sre: Pasting filtered log snippets and rollout status.

```
# rollout status
$ redwood rollout status canary-eu-2 --model redwood/gpt-3.8-compat:v2.3.0-q8
canary-eu-2: 12 pods (10 ready), version: v2.3.0-q8
recent_restarts: 0
avg_token_latency: 220ms
p99_token_latency: 1.9s
```

# pod logs (shortened)
[23:01:35] token_gen: start seq=1024 id=...
[23:01:36] kernel-select: selected kernel=attn_opt_v3 for seq=1024
[23:01:36] kv-cache: cache-miss for shard=3
[23:01:36] token_gen: step latency=1870ms
[23:01:50] token_gen: normalizing backlog

sam-eng-sre: Also grabbed diff of canary vs baseline (v2.2.7) kernel config:

```
canary(v2.3.0-q8) kernel_config: {"attn_impl":"attn_opt_v3","q_mode":"q8_fast","kv_shard_threshold":4}
baseline(v2.2.7) kernel_config: {"attn_impl":"attn_opt_v2","q_mode":"q8_stable","kv_shard_threshold":2}
```

sam-eng-sre: Hypothesis 1: attn_opt_v3 has worst-case path that triggers expensive memory copies for long sequences (seq>=512). Hypothesis 2: kv_shard_threshold change causes extra KV cache misses and recompute.

maria-ml: Agree. We saw attn_opt_v3 microbenchmarks earlier — it was faster avg but had larger variance. Canary traffic skewed toward onboarding prompts with ~700 tokens. That could expose tail regresses.

lee-product: Risk assessment: If tail latency persists we should consider rolling back canary to v2.2.7 and pin customer traffic to dedicated pools. We need quick mitigations: 1) scale up canary pods, 2) disable attn_opt_v3 kernel, or 3) rollback.

oncall-jen: Runbook check: since only canary affected and customer impact limited (no 5xx), prefer targeted config change first if quick. Sam, can you test kernel switch on a single canary pod? Maria, can you validate model correctness under older kernel?

sam-eng-sre: Doing a hot patch test — switching kernel selector on pod canary-eu-2/5 to attn_opt_v2 and reloading runtime. Will report perf in 2 mins.

ops-bot: Command executed by sam-eng-sre: `kubectl exec -it canary-eu-2-5 -- /usr/local/bin/runtimectl set-kernel attn_opt_v2 && /usr/local/bin/runtimectl reload`

sam-eng-sre: Hot-patch results: p99 token latency dropped from 1.9s -> 160ms on that pod for recent test traces. No correctness deltas in basic sanity checks.

maria-ml: Checked sample outputs vs baseline for the same prompts; no semantic regression observed in the short test. Running a 100-sample eval for safety.

lee-product: Good. Next decision: if kernel flip is low risk and quick, we can roll the change to all canary pods and hold on rollback. Is there any risk of state inconsistency with mixed kernels?

sam-eng-sre: Mixed kernels are safe; KV cache format unchanged. We can progressively flip pods. I'll create a canary-patch play to flip 3 pods, monitor for 10 minutes. If p99 stays <400ms, we proceed to full canary patch.

oncall-jen: T+12m: execute progressive kernel flip. Sam — please include monitoring dashboard snapshots and link logs here. Support/Alex: update customers "we're investigating latency, rolling a fix to canary".

sam-eng-sre: Patch started. Patch log: `patch-id 20260314-kernelflip-001`. Flip 3 pods (5,7,9).

[23:12:00] pod 5 flipped -> p99 180ms
[23:13:12] pod 7 flipped -> p99 200ms
[23:14:40] pod 9 flipped -> p99 190ms

sam-eng-sre: Aggregate canary pool p99 now 220ms, avg 210ms. No 5xx.

maria-ml: 100-sample eval done: top-k ROUGE/EM similarity within 0.5% of baseline. No functional regressions detected.

lee-product: Recommended course: do not rollback. Patch attn_impl -> attn_opt_v2 across canary and hold rollout to prod. Also add a rollback window and revert plan.

oncall-jen: Logging decision: pin production rollout until further perf testing. Action items:
- sam-eng-sre: deploy kernel flip to all canary pods (in progress).
- maria-ml: run extended eval 1k samples; abort if quality diff >1%.
- support-alex: msg affected customers with mitigation note and ETA (30m).
- ops-bot: capture baseline traces for postmortem.

support-alex: Sent templated status to acme-corp and 3 other impacted customers. No escalations.

ops-bot: Collected trace bundle `trace-2311700000-001` and stored at s3://redwood-incidents/2311700000/trace-001.tar.gz

sam-eng-sre: Completed canary-wide kernel flip. Post-patch metrics: p99 token latency stabilized at ~210ms for canary-eu-2 over 15m window. No errors.

maria-ml: Extended eval (1k) completed: quality delta 0.3% and within threshold.

lee-product: Decision summary for RM: hold rollout, update model onboarding notes to flag attn_opt_v3 variance, add perf gating for seq length distribution in future canaries.

oncall-jen: I'll open the incident RCA ticket and start timeline + hypothesis section based on this thread. Tagging @maria-ml and @sam-eng-sre for follow-ups: kernel performance tuning and rollback guardrails.

sam-eng-sre: Follow-ups (short): 1) run microbench with seq=700..1200 for attn_opt_v3 to reproduce; 2) instrument runtime to break down memory copy time; 3) add canary traffic sampler for prompt length distribution before enabling new kernels.

maria-ml: I'll coordinate with model-onboarding to require perf smoke tests for new kernel impls and add a quantization variance test.

lee-product: Thanks all. Marking incident as mitigated for now; will still collect postmortem notes. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 2026-03-14T23:32:30Z by oncall-jen. Metrics: p99 back to <400ms; customer reports cleared.
